nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Rules
nodes.rationale: Consult graphify-out/ for architecture and codebase questions; query via CLI or MCP and update graph on modifications.

nodes.label: pnpm Dependency Overrides
nodes.rationale: Pinned dependency versions for React 19.2.3, react-dom 19.2.3, and uuid 14.0.2.

nodes.label: pnpm Hoisted Node Linker Configuration
nodes.rationale: nodeLinker: hoisted configured to ensure seamless bundler and module resolution across Next.js and esbuild.

nodes.label: Driver Minimum Balance Dispatch Gate
nodes.rationale: Drivers with wallet balance below configured minimum threshold are excluded from dispatch offers.

nodes.label: D-008 Driver Wallet Gate
nodes.rationale: Drivers with wallet balance below threshold cannot receive dispatch offers.

nodes.label: Engineering Defaults and Invariants
nodes.rationale: Paise integer arithmetic, WGS84 coordinates, UTC timestamps, idempotent operations, and immutable event appending.

nodes.label: Ride Finite State Machine
nodes.rationale: Strict state transitions: REQUESTED -> OFFERING -> DRIVER_ASSIGNED -> DRIVER_EN_ROUTE -> DRIVER_ARRIVED -> TRIP_STARTED -> TRIP_COMPLETED -> PAYMENT_PENDING -> SETTLED, plus terminal EXPIRED/CANCELLED.

nodes.label: OTP Trip Start Verification
nodes.rationale: Driver must enter rider 4-digit OTP to transition ride from DRIVER_ARRIVED to TRIP_STARTED, preventing phantom trips.

nodes.label: D-009 Payment Methods
nodes.rationale: Direct driver UPI or cash collection with platform commission debited post-ride from driver wallet.

nodes.label: D-024 Mid-Trip Extension
nodes.rationale: Recalculates fare snapshot from current point to new destination with driver mutual re-acceptance.

nodes.label: JWT Access and Refresh Token Architecture
nodes.norm_label: jwt access and refresh token architecture

nodes.label: D-001 Three-Application Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separates Rider, Driver, and Admin into distinct client apps sharing a unified backend.

nodes.label: D-010 Driver Verification Workflow
nodes.rationale: Admin manual document inspection and KYC approval required before activating driver.

nodes.label: D-017 Admin Role Split
nodes.rationale: Fine-grained RBAC separating Superadmin, Operations Admin, Document Reviewer, and Support.

nodes.label: Refresh Token Rotation and Reuse Detection
nodes.norm_label: refresh token rotation and reuse detection
nodes.rationale: If a compromised refresh token is reused, all refresh tokens for that family are immediately revoked.

nodes.label: Distributed Concurrency Lock for Ride Assignment
nodes.norm_label: distributed concurrency lock for ride assignment
nodes.rationale: Prevents double-booking when multiple candidate drivers attempt to accept the same offer simultaneously.

nodes.label: Driver Offer Acceptance and Race Condition Handling
nodes.norm_label: driver offer acceptance and race condition handling

nodes.label: Negotiation Fraud and Anomalous Bidding Detection
nodes.norm_label: negotiation fraud and anomalous bidding detection

nodes.label: D-002 Negotiable Fare Model
nodes.rationale: Platform establishes bounded fare range within which driver and rider counter-offer.

nodes.label: D-013 Negotiation Bounds
nodes.rationale: Driver floor fixed at 80-90% of base fare; ceiling fixed at 120-130% to prevent predatory surge or unprofitable dumping.

nodes.label: Module Minimum Testing Requirements
nodes.rationale: Happy path, invalid input, boundary conditions, state transition failures, external failure behavior, concurrency-sensitive behavior.

nodes.label: Adding a Module Workflow
nodes.rationale: Ensures domain boundary, acceptance criteria, pure domain logic first, then use cases, infrastructure adapters, interface, tests, and documentation.

nodes.label: Critical E2E User Flows
nodes.rationale: Rider flow, Driver onboarding/ride flow, Admin review/pricing flow.

nodes.label: Edge-Case Testing Matrix
nodes.rationale: Negotiation bounds/timeouts, no drivers, simultaneous accept, buffer classification, interstate routes, zero wallet, cash dispute, spoofed GPS.

nodes.label: Adapter & Infrastructure Integration Testing
nodes.rationale: Repositories, routing adapter, KYC adapter, payment adapter, auth flows, realtime infra using test sandboxes.

nodes.label: Cabzon Testing Pyramid
nodes.rationale: Unit tests as foundation, integration tests for adapters/repositories, E2E for critical user journeys.

nodes.label: Deterministic Business Logic Unit Testing
nodes.rationale: Prioritize fare calculation, negotiation bounds, zone classification, ride state transitions, wallet eligibility, commission.

nodes.label: Sequential Domain Development Order
nodes.rationale: Auth -> Driver onboarding -> City zones/pricing -> Fare calculation -> Ride request -> Negotiation -> Acceptance -> Trip -> Payment -> Wallet -> Ratings/reviews.

nodes.label: Module Prerequisites Checklist
nodes.rationale: Identify product requirement, domain boundary, existing module ownership, decision log status, external deps, acceptance criteria before coding.

nodes.label: Business Invariant Regression Mandate
nodes.rationale: A bug in a business invariant must result in a regression test before the fix is considered complete.

nodes.label: Polygon Geofence Classification ($geoIntersects)
nodes.rationale: Classifies pickup and drop points against city polygon boundaries with highest geographic precision.

nodes.label: D-006 Polygon-First Zone Classification
nodes.rationale: Strict polygon boundary matching with radial buffer fallback when outside defined polygon.

nodes.label: D-007 Interstate Route Segmentation
nodes.rationale: Interstate trips segmented by state border crossing for accurate taxation, permits, and state-specific base rates.

nodes.label: D-014 Buffer-Zone Distance
nodes.rationale: Radial distance buffer beyond city limits with dedicated surcharge.

nodes.label: Application Boundary
nodes.rationale: Use cases coordinate business operations; controllers should not contain substantial domain logic.

nodes.label: Mechanical Boundary Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Type checking, linting, formatting, import boundaries, test execution, secret scanning, dependency checks, build verification.

nodes.label: Rider and Driver Mobile Applications
nodes.rationale: Independent apps in apps/rider-mobile and apps/driver-mobile; do not force rider and driver UI into same component tree.

nodes.label: Driver Mobile Responsibilities
nodes.rationale: Availability, ride offers, live location, background tracking, push notification handling.

nodes.label: Rider Mobile Responsibilities
nodes.rationale: Booking, fare negotiation, live tracking, booking for others, payment status, ratings/reviews.

nodes.label: Untrusted Client Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: Mobile/web clients are untrusted. Server must revalidate authentication, authorization, fare limits, ride state, driver eligibility, wallet eligibility, payment state.

nodes.label: Authoritative Realtime Boundary
nodes.rationale: Realtime transport is not authoritative. Received client event does not prove business action occurred; server validates command and persists state.

nodes.label: Mobile Zero-Trust Security
nodes.rationale: Never embed server secrets in mobile apps; backend authoritative enforcement.

nodes.label: Mobile Shared Code Policy
nodes.rationale: Share only platform/product neutral code (API contracts, validation, domain value types, formatting utilities, design tokens).

nodes.label: Map Interaction & Zone Visualization Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Map interactions must not hide primary action; zone editing must clearly distinguish current boundary, selected zone, proposed changes, saved state.

nodes.label: Cabzon UI Design Character
nodes.rationale: Prioritize clarity, speed, trust, legibility, low cognitive load, and strong status communication.

nodes.label: Role-Based Interface Priorities
nodes.rationale: Rider UI prioritizes fare/trip visibility; Driver UI prioritizes offer speed & ride status; Admin UI prioritizes tables, filters, and geometry.

nodes.label: Admin Web Feature Modular Architecture
nodes.rationale: Structured by features (drivers, zones, pricing, rides, disputes, users) with distinct components, services, state, and lib.

nodes.label: Frontend API Abstraction Boundary
nodes.rationale: UI components should not directly call provider SDKs or DB; calls flow through feature use case client to API.

nodes.label: Frontend Realtime Contract Consumption
nodes.rationale: Consume application realtime contracts rather than implementing business rules inside UI components.

nodes.label: Multi-Modal Status Indicator Standard
nodes.rationale: Ride states must have visually distinct status treatments; avoid communicating state only through color; use text/icons for accessibility.

nodes.label: Feature Ownership Boundary
nodes.rationale: A feature owns its screens, feature components, API calls, local state, validation, and feature-level tests.

nodes.label: Five Distinct State Categories
nodes.rationale: Keep server state, form state, UI state, auth state, and realtime state separate; do not use a single monolithic global store.

nodes.label: Monorepo Proposed Directory Structure
nodes.rationale: apps/ (api, admin, rider-mobile, driver-mobile), packages/ (domain, contracts, validation, config, ui, utilities), docs/, scripts/.

nodes.label: packages/contracts Specification
nodes.rationale: API request/response types, realtime event shapes, common identifiers, shared enumerations.

nodes.label: packages/domain Specification
nodes.rationale: Truly shared domain logic; do not create shared package simply for cosmetic file similarity.

nodes.label: packages/validation Specification
nodes.rationale: Cross-application reusable validation rules.

nodes.label: Monorepo Package & App Isolation Rules
nodes.rationale: apps contain deployables; packages contain reusable code; critical domain rules must not be duplicated; API infra must not leak to mobile.

nodes.label: Source Boundary Rule
nodes.rationale: Product requirements come from prd.md; product decisions from decision-log.md. Engineering choices are proposals until explicitly approved.

nodes.label: Shared Package Dependency & Non-Circularity Rules
nodes.rationale: Avoid circular dependencies; avoid importing application code into shared packages; keep packages small with clear owners.

nodes.label: Anti-Fraud Loopholes and Defenses
nodes.rationale: Mitigates GPS spoofing, cash payment fraud, off-platform passenger collusion, and unverified trip starts via OTP.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Fare Concepts
nodes.rationale: Separates base calculation from driver minimum floor and negotiation ceiling to give predictable prices while allowing driver-rider negotiation.

nodes.label: Base Route Fare Calculation Formula
nodes.rationale: Deterministic pricing formula incorporating base fare, included km, extra distance rate, duration rate, and zone buffer.

nodes.label: Immutable Fare Snapshotting
nodes.rationale: Locks base fare, discount, estimated distance, and bounds at ride creation.

nodes.label: D-003 Three Fare Concepts
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes Base Calculated Fare, Driver Negotiation Floor, and Upper Ceiling.

nodes.label: D-004 Route-Based Fare Calculation
nodes.rationale: Calculates pricing along exact turn-by-turn routing rather than straight-line haversine distance.

nodes.label: D-005 Freeze Fare Inputs at Ride Request
nodes.norm_label: d-005 freeze fare inputs at ride request
nodes.rationale: Snapshots distance, estimated duration, and pricing configuration at ride creation to avoid mid-ride price drift.

nodes.label: D-015 Vehicle-Based Pricing
nodes.rationale: Separate base rates, per-km, and per-minute rates based on vehicle tier (Hatchback, Sedan, SUV, Auto).

nodes.label: Application Layer Use Cases
nodes.rationale: Contains use cases (RequestRide, ProposeFare, AcceptRide, StartTrip, CompleteTrip, RequestExtension, VerifyDriver, TopUpWallet, SubmitReview).

nodes.label: Domain Layer Architecture
nodes.rationale: Pure business logic (ride rules, fare concepts, negotiation, zones, wallet, driver eligibility) with zero dependencies on frameworks.

nodes.label: Infrastructure Layer Adapters
nodes.rationale: Adapters for database, KYC, routing, payment, push notifications, realtime transport, file storage.

nodes.label: Interface Presentation Layer
nodes.rationale: REST controllers, WebSocket handlers, admin controllers, mobile/web presentation logic.

nodes.label: Domain Layer Boundary
nodes.rationale: Business rules must not depend directly on HTTP framework, database driver, UI framework, KYC SDK, payment SDK, or routing SDK.

nodes.label: Offline Domain Testability Rule
nodes.rationale: Domain layer must remain executable and testable without a running database or external provider.

nodes.label: SOLID Architecture Application
nodes.rationale: SRP (fare service calculates fare only), OCP (provider adapters behind interfaces), LSP (swappable adapters), ISP (focused interfaces), DIP (depend on abstractions).

nodes.label: Monorepo Dependency Direction Flow
nodes.rationale: apps -> application use-case layer -> domain -> contracts / pure utilities; infrastructure adapters implement application interfaces.

nodes.label: Platform Commission Snapshot and Post-Ride Deduction
nodes.norm_label: platform commission snapshot and post-ride deduction

nodes.label: Immutable Double-Entry Ledger
nodes.rationale: All wallet balance adjustments are strictly appended as immutable credit/debit transactions; wallet balance is always the sum of transactions.

nodes.label: D-016 Commission Model
nodes.rationale: Percentage commission on final settled fare automatically deducted from driver wallet.

nodes.label: Explicit Distance & Date Standards
nodes.rationale: Explicit distance units; consistent timestamp storage converted only at presentation boundaries.

nodes.label: Ubiquitous Domain Terminology Naming
nodes.rationale: Use domain terminology consistently: suggestedFare, riderProposedFare, agreedFare, pickup, drop, cityZone, wallet, commission; avoid synonyms.

nodes.label: Structured Error Representation
nodes.rationale: Errors must have stable machine-readable code, safe human-readable message, and relevant contextual data.

nodes.label: Smallest-Unit Integer Money Representation
nodes.rationale: Represent money using integer smallest-unit representation; never use floating-point arithmetic for monetary calculations.

nodes.label: Sensitive Data Redaction Logging Policy
nodes.rationale: Never log OTP values, auth secrets, government documents, or payment credentials.

nodes.label: Automated Pull Request Verification Flow
nodes.rationale: Developer -> PR -> Automated checks (Typecheck, Lint, Unit tests, Build) -> Review -> Staging -> E2E -> Production.

nodes.label: Production Observability Minimums
nodes.rationale: Application logs, error monitoring, request correlation, health checks, provider failure visibility.

nodes.label: Database Migration and Rollback Controls
nodes.rationale: Schema changes must be version controlled, tested on staging, reversible where practical, with documented rollback plan.

nodes.label: Reproducible Build Principles
nodes.rationale: Production builds must be reproducible from source control without depending on developer machine state; never commit production secrets.

nodes.label: Source of Truth Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Code > LLD > Decision Log > PRD: Lower-level technical specifications supersede high-level product documents.

nodes.label: Ride Module Reference Structure
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates clean separation: domain/ride.ts, application/request-ride.ts, infrastructure/ride-repository.ts, interface/ride-controller.ts.

nodes.label: Standard Module Anatomy
nodes.rationale: Standard module layout: domain/, application/, infrastructure/, interface/, tests/, and index.ts.

nodes.label: Module Encapsulation and Access Rules
nodes.rationale: Explicit public exports, private internals, cross-module access via contracts/use cases, never import another module's private infrastructure.

nodes.label: Mongo Service (Production)
nodes.rationale: Mongo 7 replica set instance rs0 closed from host access in production

nodes.label: Redis Service (Production)
nodes.rationale: Redis 7-alpine with appendonly persistence closed from host access

nodes.label: Deployment Environments (Dev/Staging/Prod)
nodes.rationale: Separate development, staging, production environments with isolated credentials and configuration.

nodes.label: Core Product Boundary
nodes.rationale: Cabzon contains Rider Mobile App, Driver Mobile App, Admin Web Dashboard covering driver verification, rider auth, zones, pricing, negotiation, dispatch, execution, payments, wallet, ratings, disputes.

nodes.label: Proposed Baseline Technology Matrix
nodes.rationale: Node.js+TS backend, REST HTTP API, MongoDB, WebSocket realtime, FCM push fallback, Mongo geospatial+Turf.js, Redis cache.

nodes.label: Admin Controlled Parameters
nodes.rationale: City polygons, base fare, rate/km, minimum fare, included KM, buffer surcharge, state-specific interstate rate/km.

nodes.label: External Service Categories Requirements
nodes.rationale: KYC (Cashfree/Surepass), Routing (Google/Mapbox), Payment (UPI/Cash), Location/Mapping.

nodes.label: Development Setup Framework
nodes.rationale: Separates mandatory PRD requirements from engineering choices left to development team.

nodes.label: Required Workspace Applications
nodes.rationale: Rider Mobile App, Driver Mobile App, Admin Web Dashboard with explicit capability sets.

nodes.label: Mandatory Decision Logging Rule
nodes.rationale: Never silently turn an implementation preference into project standard; document in decision-log.md.

nodes.label: Technology Selection Criteria
nodes.rationale: Requires owner, rationale, alternatives considered, operational impact, migration/exit implications.

nodes.label: Environment Isolation Matrix
nodes.rationale: Separate Dev, Staging, Production with isolated database, credentials, and configuration; never commit secrets.

nodes.label: Definition of Development Readiness
nodes.rationale: Module development ready when requirements unambiguous, open questions resolved, external deps chosen, edge cases documented, tests exist.
